system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:31 UTC, a Windows 4648 event on WS-LPARK-01 recorded SYSTEM using explicit credentials for svc-claimsync, targeting PROXY-HD-01; the process was C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe.

The recorded process and host differ from the inventory-listed approved backup agent, which is CobaltVault's cvagent.exe on FILE-HD-01. This discrepancy warrants investigation but does not by itself establish malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: Windows Security and Sysmon collection was unavailable on DC-HD-01 and FILE-HD-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a log collection outage.
Although proxy, Zeek connection, DNS, and SSL sensors are reported as available, no corresponding records were provided.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-claimsync authentication succeeded or failed; the supplied 4648 event alone does not establish the outcome.
Whether there were repeated failed domain logons during the alert window; no such records were supplied.
Whether the Commvault process on WS-LPARK-01 was authorized, how it was launched, or whether it made network connections.
Whether the event was related to the scheduled password rotation or to the expected ClaimSync job activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain DC-HD-01 authentication logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC, including relevant success and failure events for svc-claimsync.
Recover or obtain FILE-HD-01 Windows Security and Sysmon logs for the same period, along with ClaimSync job, service, and password-update records.
Obtain proxy and network-flow records for the event time to determine whether WS-LPARK-01 connected to PROXY-HD-01 and what activity followed.
Review WS-LPARK-01 process execution, software installation, and endpoint security telemetry to establish the origin and legitimacy of GxCVD.exe.
